newsitem.title: UK: Compass sets 220 mln stg convertible bond.
newsitem.headline: Compass sets 220 mln stg convertible bond.

text.p: Compass Group Plc has launched a 220 million stg convertible bond due October 2007, NatWest Markets said on Monday.
HSBC is joint lead manager of the transaction.
The deal has an indicated semi-annual coupon of 5.75-6.0 percent and a conversion premium of 19-22 percent.
The issue price is par and there is an option to increase the principal amount by 30 million stg.
Fees total 2.5 percent and the pay date is July 29, 1997. There is a short first coupon on October 5, 1997.
The bonds are listed in London and negative pledge and cross default apply.
There is no call until October 28, 2002.
